title: Fix device access revocation not logging out existing sessions
body:
<!--
Ensure your title is short, descriptive, and in the imperative mood (Fix X, Change Y, instead of Fixed X, Changed Y).
For a good inspiration of what to write in commit messages and PRs please review https://chris.beams.io/posts/git-commit/ and our https://jellyfin.org/docs/general/contributing/issues/ page.
-->

**Changes**
Removing a device from a user's allowed device list or switching off enable all devices only applied to new logins. Since commit d986a824cd which converted `DeviceAccessHost` from an `IServerEntryPoint` to an `IHostedService` (which needs an explicit `AddHostedService`), `DeviceAccessHost` was never run and `OnUserUpdated` was only raised for `RenameUser`. Fixed in `UpdatePolicyAsync` in UserManager.cs by hoisting the user out of the lock scope and raising `OnUserUpdated` so it doesn't only apply to renames and then adding `AddHostedService<DeviceAccessHost>()` in Startup.cs. Added a logger to DeviceAccessHost.cs and a try/catch block around `OnUserUpdated` body. As a side effect of adding `_eventManager.PublishAsync(eventArgs)`, `UserUpdatedNotifier` now emits a user updated notification on policy change. I included 4 regression tests.

**Code assistance**
<!-- If code assistance was used, describe how it contributed
e.g., code generated by LLM, explanation of code base, debugging guidance. -->

Defect found by an LLM audit, then Opus 5 wrote the fix and regression tests and ran the test suite. Verified the changes myself.

**Issues**
<!-- Tag any issues that this PR solves here.
ex. Fixes # -->
None
